deploy-bot: Created release tag `v2.3.0-rc1` on `main` (commit `3f4a9b2`).
Changelog (short):
• batching heuristics: lower-latency batching for variable seqs
• kv-cache: fix memory growth on long-lived sessions
• tokenizer: pin transformer-tokenizer v1.2.3 to avoid OOV regression
• dedicated: add canary routing config and auto-fallback policy
Full changelog: https://git.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.0-rc1/CHANGELOG.md
Environment: staging
Canary: 10 instances (traffic 10%)
Started rollout: now
---
alice.k: cutting RC, kicking off smoke tests. will follow up with canary metrics.
bob.s: noted. watching p50/p95 for model-serving and token throughput.
carla.pm: adding short blurb for docs site and marketing playbook. tagging release notes draft.
dave-oncall: standing by for infra alerts. suggest 30m rollback window after prod cut. :eyes: 
alice.k: smoke tests green on staging, no regressions in eval harness. canary healthy after 6 minutes.
bob.s: small 2-3% latency blip during canary warmup, back to baseline. no errors flagged.
alice.k: promoting `v2.3.0-rc1` to production (plan: gradual 5%-25%-50%-100% over 15min).
deploy-bot: Promotion step: staging -> production started. Tag: `v2.3.0-rc1`, commit: `3f4a9b2`. Rollout policy: gradual (5,25,50,100). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/1749023145
ci-bot: Prod deploy job #4521 started on cluster-prod-4.
ci-bot: Prod deploy job #4521: step complete on 6/6 pods. health checks passed.
dave-oncall: infra metrics look stable. no spike in error rates. keeping rollback window.
bob.s: monitoring model-serving tracer: tail ops show normal latency-distribution.
carla.pm: publishing external release notes now. included known issue about tokenizer pinning for downstream SDKs. :tada:
alice.k: marking internal postmortem/notes for migration team re: tokenizer pin. will create follow-up ticket.
deploy-bot: Release `v2.3.0-rc1` promoted to production and marked complete. Duration: ~18m.
alice.k: thanks team — will wait out rollback window then close the thread. :white_check_mark:
dave-oncall: rollback window expired, closing watch. all good from oncall.
carla.pm: external release notes published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v2.3.0
alice.k: tagging this thread with: release/cut, deploy/prod. closing.
deploy-bot: Thread closed by alice.k.
